correctness.rationale: With ε=1/g, the mass-preserving real polynomial flow is smooth in ε on compact s=gt intervals and its ε=0 solution is e^{is} at the root and zero elsewhere. In the Taylor coefficient recursion the hopping term at order k uses order k−1; the off-root cubic uses lower orders because each factor has vanishing order zero. Induction gives zero coefficients below the distance h, and at order h only predecessor edges contribute. The leading coefficient therefore integrates the geodesic-count recursion with R_h′=iR_{h−1} for h≥2. The root's first variation is homogeneous and vanishes; hence a neighbor's second coefficient is (A²)_{vo}R_2. In the squared-amplitude cross term Re(conj(R_1)R_2)=2(1−cos s)−s sin s, and the sum of (A²)_{vo} over neighbors is (A³)_{oo}=2T_o. Distance-two and farther sites contribute only from order g^−4, giving the stated sign and the coefficient 16T_o at s=π. Separately, mass and energy conservation give gq(1−q)≤2√(d_o q(1−q))+||B||q for leakage q and root-deleted adjacency B. For g>4||A||, q=1/2 is impossible, and continuity from q=0 confines the flow below it. Absorbing ||B||q with q≤1/2 gives q≤8d_o/(g−2||B||)² uniformly for large g; substituting this into the divided inequality gives the sharp limsup 4d_o. Evaluation at π/g gives the matching liminf. Only the supremum result is global in physical time; the expansions are compact in s with a fixed graph.
correctness.verification: The uploaded RK4 verifier and its report of 117 assertions were inspected as recorded evidence, not executed. Independently, rk4_finite_check.py at /workspace/branches/a45d35e0-3690-4314-aa56-8d35dbcb2415/rk4_finite_check.py integrated a five-vertex graph with root degree two, one root triangle, and two geodesics each to vertices at distances two and three, using 10,000 RK4 steps to s=π for g=40,80,160. Mass errors were at most 1.1e−14; g² times leakage was 8.427556, 8.206960, 8.101746, and g⁴(q−8/g²−16/g³) was 44.088813, 44.545011, 44.689750. Scaled amplitude errors were bounded in those trials. This is finite floating-point corroboration, not an all-time or rigorous numerical certification.

value.rationale: The theorem ties a natural localized evolution to three different rooted graph invariants: onset order gives distance, amplitude gives geodesic multiplicity, and the first correction to leakage gives triangles. It also shows a leading global bound is attained on the short time scale, beyond simply proving confinement. These are useful fixed-graph asymptotics; they do not establish growing-network uniformity, stability of inverse motif recovery, or an all-time higher-order expansion.
